title: Hand in PEARL KIOSK, PDFs and EVIDENCE

questions.label: 1a
questions.question_text: Change the slide size to 16:10. Take a screenshot of the Slide Size window and paste it into EVIDENCE at 1a.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Slide size 16:10 shown in the screenshot.
Check / do not accept: Screenshot must be readable. 16:9 not accepted.

questions.label: 1b
questions.question_text: Set the background to the BACKGROUND image at 60% transparency.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: BACKGROUND image on all slides at 60% transparency.
Check / do not accept: Accept 55–65%. Image applied slide by slide but at 60% on every slide: accept.

questions.label: 1c
questions.question_text: Set the title text colour to dark blue so that it has high contrast with the background.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Dark blue title text with high contrast against the background.
Check / do not accept: Black or light blue not accepted.

questions.label: 1d
questions.question_text: Make all slide titles bold and italic.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: All titles bold and italic.
Check / do not accept: Must be on every slide title.

questions.label: 1e
questions.question_text: Insert the LOGO in the top right corner so that it appears on every slide.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: LOGO top right on every slide.
Check / do not accept: Logo copied onto each slide in the same place: accept.

questions.label: 1f
questions.question_text: Add the footer text Pearl Coast Aquarium – Visitor Information in the centre of the footer, and a date that updates automatically.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Footer text Pearl Coast Aquarium – Visitor Information centred, and an automatically updating date.
Check / do not accept: Both needed. A fixed typed date not accepted.

questions.label: 1g
questions.question_text: Add a slide number on the right. Do not show the footer or slide number on the title slide.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Slide number on the right, and no footer or slide number on slide 1.
Check / do not accept: Both needed.

questions.label: 1h
questions.question_text: Hide the date placeholder on the Two Content layout master.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: No date on slides 3 and 6 (Two Content), date shown on slides 2, 4 and 5.
Check / do not accept: Date deleted from individual slides instead of the layout master: do not accept if the screenshot shows it is still on the layout.

questions.label: 1i
questions.question_text: Add a picture placeholder to the Title Only layout master.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Picture placeholder on the Title Only layout (slide 2 image sits in a picture placeholder).
Check / do not accept: Image inserted with Insert > Pictures on slide 2 only: not accepted.

questions.label: 1j
questions.question_text: Take a screenshot of Slide Master view that shows the slide master and the layout masters. Paste it into EVIDENCE at 1j. Close Slide Master view before you add any content.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Screenshot of Slide Master view showing the slide master and the layout masters, with house style applied; no slide content added to the master.
Check / do not accept: Normal view screenshot not accepted.

questions.label: 2a
questions.question_text: Add every slide using New Slide and the layout shown in the table, so that every slide uses the master slide.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: All six slides use the stated layouts and the master (background, logo, footer appear on every slide).
Check / do not accept: Blank slides with drawn text boxes not accepted.

questions.label: 2b
questions.question_text: Select text from PEARL TEXT and enter it into the placeholders as short bullet points. Do not paste whole paragraphs.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Text selected from PEARL TEXT as short bullet points on slides 3 and 4.
Check / do not accept: Whole paragraphs pasted, or café/history text included: not accepted.

questions.label: 2c
questions.question_text: Insert the images into the placeholders. Every image must be relevant to the aquarium.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Images in placeholders: TURTLE (slide 3), JELLYFISH (slide 6) and a relevant image on slide 2.
Check / do not accept: CAMEL used anywhere: no mark.

questions.label: 2d
questions.question_text: The directions in PEARL TEXT are too long for a slide. On slide 5, replace the directions with the MAP image so that the slide gives the same information with less reading.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Slide 5 shows the MAP image instead of the directions paragraph.
Check / do not accept: A short caption is fine. Directions paragraph still present: not accepted.

questions.label: 2e
questions.question_text: Resize the TURTLE image on slide 3 and the JELLYFISH image on slide 6 to exactly 10 cm wide and 7.5 cm high.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: TURTLE and JELLYFISH both 10 cm × 7.5 cm.
Check / do not accept: Check Picture Format > Size in the file. Accept ±0.1 cm.

questions.label: 2f
questions.question_text: Make sure your slides are fit for purpose for visitors: easy to read, with no text or images overlapping and no stretched images.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Fit for purpose: readable font size, clear hierarchy, nothing overlapping or cut off, no distorted images.
Check / do not accept: Holistic judgement across all slides.

questions.label: 3a
questions.question_text: On slide 3, apply the same entrance effect to each exhibit name only. Do not animate the title, the image or the logo.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: The same entrance effect on each of the three exhibit names on slide 3, and nothing else animated.
Check / do not accept: Title, image or logo animated: no mark. Different effects: no mark.

questions.label: 3b
questions.question_text: Use the Animation Pane so that the exhibit names appear one after another, each starting After Previous.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Animation Pane order matches the list, each starting After Previous.
Check / do not accept: On Click or With Previous not accepted.

questions.label: 3c
questions.question_text: Set the duration of each exhibit name animation to 2 seconds.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Duration 2 seconds on each exhibit name animation.
Check / do not accept: Delay of 2 s instead of duration: not accepted.

questions.label: 3d
questions.question_text: On slide 1, add a transition that moves to slide 2 automatically after 5 seconds, not on mouse click.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Slide 1 transition: After 00:05.00 ticked and On Mouse Click unticked.
Check / do not accept: Both settings needed.

questions.label: 3e
questions.question_text: Take a screenshot of the Animation Pane for slide 3 and a screenshot of the Transitions tab for slide 1. Paste them into EVIDENCE at 3e.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Both screenshots present and readable (Animation Pane for slide 3, Transitions tab for slide 1).
Check / do not accept: Both needed.

questions.label: 4a
questions.question_text: On slide 2, add a hyperlink from the text Our Exhibits to slide 3.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Our Exhibits on slide 2 links to slide 3.
Check / do not accept: Test in Slide Show view.

questions.label: 4b
questions.question_text: Add hyperlinks from the other three menu items to slides 4, 5 and 6, so that every menu item works.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: The other three menu items link to slides 4, 5 and 6.
Check / do not accept: All three must work.

questions.label: 4c
questions.question_text: On slides 3, 4, 5 and 6, add a Home action button that links to slide 2 (Menu). The button must be in the same position on every slide.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Home action button on slides 3–6, linked to slide 2, in the same position on every slide.
Check / do not accept: Linked to Next Slide or First Slide: not accepted. Text hyperlink instead of an action button: not accepted.

questions.label: 4d
questions.question_text: Take a screenshot of the Action Settings window for the Home action button. Paste it into EVIDENCE at 4d.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Screenshot of Action Settings showing Hyperlink to: slide 2 (Menu).
Check / do not accept: Must be readable.

questions.label: 4e
questions.question_text: On slide 6, add a hyperlink to the website http://www.pearlcoast.service and a hyperlink to the email address visit@pearlcoast.service
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Website link http://www.pearlcoast.service and email link mailto:visit@pearlcoast.service on slide 6.
Check / do not accept: Both needed. Check spelling.

questions.label: 4f
questions.question_text: On slide 4, add a hyperlink from the text See all ticket prices to the file TICKET PRICES.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: See all ticket prices on slide 4 links to the TICKET PRICES file.
Check / do not accept: Link to a web address not accepted.

questions.label: 5a
questions.question_text: Add the speaker notes from PEARL TEXT to slide 4.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Speaker notes from PEARL TEXT on slide 4.
Check / do not accept: Check NOTES PDF or the file.

questions.label: 5b
questions.question_text: Enter your name and class in the Notes and Handouts footer.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Name and class in the Notes and Handouts footer, visible on HANDOUTS or NOTES.
Check / do not accept: Typed on the slide footer instead: not accepted.

questions.label: 5c
questions.question_text: Print all slides as handouts with 3 slides per page. Print to PDF and name the file HANDOUTS.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: HANDOUTS PDF: 3 slides per page, all six slides (2 pages).
Check / do not accept: Other layouts not accepted.

questions.label: 5d
questions.question_text: Print the notes page for slide 4 only. Print to PDF and name the file NOTES.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: NOTES PDF: notes page for slide 4 showing the slide and its notes.
Check / do not accept: Notes page for a different slide not accepted.

questions.label: 5e
questions.question_text: Print slide 1 as a full page slide. Print to PDF and name the file FULL PAGE.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: FULL PAGE PDF: slide 1 as one full page slide.

questions.label: S1
questions.question_text: The aquarium used a master slide for its presentation. Explain one benefit of using a master slide.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: One benefit with expansion, e.g. consistent look on every slide (1) so the presentation follows the house style and looks professional (1); OR quicker to change (1) because only the master needs editing and every slide updates (1); OR quicker to add slides (1) because background, logo and footer are already in place (1).
Check / do not accept: Accept placeholders fix where content goes (1) so layout stays consistent (1). Benefit without expansion: 1 mark.

questions.label: S2
questions.question_text: State one reason why too much text should not be put on a slide.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: The audience reads instead of listening; slides should show only key points; too much text is hard to read on a screen.

questions.label: S3
questions.question_text: State the difference between an animation and a transition.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: An animation is applied to an object on a slide; a transition is applied when moving from one slide to the next.
Check / do not accept: Both sides needed for the mark.

questions.label: S4
questions.question_text: Describe how animations can improve the kiosk presentation, and why using too many animations reduces their impact.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Animations draw attention to important information / control when information appears (1). Too many animations distract the visitor, lose their impact or look unprofessional (1).

questions.label: S5
questions.question_text: Explain why action buttons are useful for a presentation shown in kiosk mode.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: There is no presenter or keyboard at a kiosk (1) so action buttons let visitors control which slide they see / navigate themselves (1).
Check / do not accept: Accept: On Mouse Click is turned off, so only the buttons move the show (1).

questions.label: S6
questions.question_text: Aquarium staff also give talks to school groups. State when the staff should use each of these print layouts: (i) handouts (ii) notes pages (iii) full page slides.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: (i) Handouts: given to the audience/pupils to follow the talk and make notes (1). (ii) Notes pages: for the presenter/staff to use as a script (1). (iii) Full page slides: for a display or poster (1).

questions.label: S7
questions.question_text: Describe two ways Presenter View can support a member of staff giving a talk.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Any two: shows the speaker notes on the presenter's screen (1); previews the next slide (1); shows a timer to keep track of time (1); no need to print notes pages (1).
